name: Bloom and Requiem
source:
Bloom and Requiem is a kinetic micro visual novel of 1k words of prose and reflection between Ari's past self (the fragmented memory that has almost faded from depression) and future self (the fragmented memory that shares recovered feelings of what different types of love has felt like for them). 

[From [url=https://bardicblaze.itch.io/bloom-from-requiem]Itch.io[/url]]
